title: FLEX-Judge: Text-Only Reasoning Unleashes Zero-Shot Multimodal Evaluators

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the length distribution of responses preferred by the judge model against human preferences in pairwise comparisons to determine if the model systematically favors longer answers regardless of quality.

Analyzing the frequency with which the judge model prefers the first versus the second response in pairwise comparisons, compared to human evaluators, to detect systematic preferences for specific positions in the prompt.
